newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian central bank reserves up in July.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian central bank reserves up in July.

text.p: The Bank of Lithuania's reserve money and official reserves increased for the fourth consecutive month in July, the central bank said on Thursday.
Reserve money rose 4.9 percent from 2.21 billion litas to 2.32 billion, but remained below the end-1995 level of 2.43 billion, the central bank said in a monthly bulletin.
Official reserves jumped 9.4 percent from $734.4 million to $803.7 million, still less than the end-1995 total of $819.0 million.
The Bank of Lithuania also said it put 55.8 million litas into circulation by selling U.S. dollars, bringing the total amount in circulation to 2.04 billion litas.
